generalizations: The three lanes are original LazyTravel decision patterns, not operator itineraries or timetables
One anchor per day is an editorial capacity rule, not a claim that every traveller moves at the same pace
Upper-chain, lake, rail, old-road, and highland labels group route decisions and do not replace live station-level routing
Fallbacks require their own opening, access, meal, lodging, warning, and transport checks
A weather warning, unsafe condition, or operator instruction overrides the diagram
